name: Connect to canonical Woo abilities through WordPress MCP
query: Connect my local WooCommerce site to my MCP client so it can query products.
expected_behavior: Inspect WordPress, Woo, wp ability, and the MCP Adapter default server
Use local WP-CLI STDIO with mcp-adapter-default-server
Discover Woo abilities through the adapter discovery tool rather than expecting top-level Woo tools
Inspect the product-query schema and test a minimal read-only query
success_criteria: The standard WordPress MCP server is configured
No Woo REST API key or deprecated endpoint is requested
No write or destructive ability is used for verification
